Foreign Key to Dish. Part of composite PK.
Price at booking time. Copied from Dish.UnitPrice.
Optional notes for this menu item.

column4:
- Combination of (BookingId, DishId) must be unique.
- Cannot add same dish twice to one booking.

- Quantity must be greater than 0.
- If invalid, system shows: "Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0!"

- UnitPrice is captured at booking time to preserve historical pricing.
- Changes to Dish.UnitPrice do not affect existing bookings.

- Each booking must have at least one menu item.
- If empty, system shows: "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một món ăn!"
